dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature of the trailing edge boundary forming a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a small pixel radius at the highest vertical point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear anterior margin inclined at approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal pixel baseline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Discrete white depigmented mark or scar visible at the anterior base of the fin; subtle linear surface scratches on the lateral flank.
